visualCharacteristics: A horizontal, sticky in-page jump-navigation bar of pill-shaped links. Scrolls horizontally on mobile, wraps and centers on desktop. Clicking a link smooth-scrolls to the matching in-page anchor.
contentPattern: A list of links, each pointing to an in-page anchor (e.g. 'My car cover' -> #anchor_Mycarcover), plus an optional 'Back to top' link.
usage: In-page category jump navigation for long pages such as FAQ or guide pages.
